meta.notes: A particle description lists the pictures the client draws a particle type with, from the particle atlas: msm_examples:blue_flame is the picture textures/particle/blue_flame.png of this project. Named minecraft:flame, it replaces the pictures of vanilla's flame particle, so torches, furnaces and spawners show blue flames. A description in a resource pack needs no mod: it only changes the look, never how the particle moves or how long it lives. List several pictures to animate it; a description for a type that does not exist is ignored.
